TRANSACTION - FUNCTIONAL DESCRIPTION: transaction transaction to obtain a price rule by your id
EXECUTION FLOWS - DETAILED DESCRIPTION: 1. Input and validations: the transaction reads pricingRuleId from the input and, when pricingRuleId is not null and is lower than 0, it adds advice ABKO00000050 with warning severity. 2. Decisions and branches: after the validation branch, the flow continues in all cases and does not stop before invoking the library. 3. Libraries and invoked methods: the transaction obtains ABKOR000 through getServiceLibrary(ABKOR000.class) and invokes executeGetPricingRuleById(pricingRuleId); the library builds base query parameters, queries the database with pricingRuleId, returns null when the query result is empty, and otherwise maps the first row into pricingRule.id, pricingRule.name, pricingRule.active, pricingRule.status, pricingRule.type, pricingRule.creationDate, pricingRule.effectiveDate.startDate, pricingRule.effectiveDate.endDate, pricingRule.fee.feeType, pricingRule.fee.value, pricingRule.activity, pricingRule.segment, pricingRule.settlement, pricingRule.paymentMethods, pricingRule.customAttributes, pricingRule.proggresiveType, pricingRule.precedence, pricingRule.parentPricingRuleId, pricingRule.version and pricingRule.comment. 4. Errors and follow-up actions: when the library returns null, the transaction adds advice ABKO00000040 with warning severity. 5. Outputs and assignment conditions: the transaction always assigns the output pricingRule with the PricingRuleGetDTO returned by the library through setPricingrule(priceRule), even when that returned value is null.

Accessed Libraries.Description: Retrieves the pricing rule identified by pricingRuleId from the database and maps the first returned row into PricingRuleGetDTO.

Error Management.Description of the error situation: Invalid parameter: pricingRuleId must be non-negative.
